$description: A single brand definition that emits BOTH a dark and a light theme via `$modes`. Shared identity (indigo/cyan accents, cool-indigo surfaces from `$ramp`) lives at the top level; each mode adds only what differs. The light mode keeps the same neon signal ramp but turns on `$fitSignals`, so those bright signals are auto-darkened to stay legible on the near-white surfaces. Build → dist/themes/aurora.css (dark) + dist/themes/aurora-light.css.
